title: Symbols category, Flag Shades, Herby Powiatów, and Flagdle grid normalization
body:
- Added the Symbols category featuring Flagdle, Flag Shades (grayscale flag challenge with a 3-guess color hint), and Herby Powiatów (Polish county coats of arms with automatic registration plate reveal after the 5th wrong guess).
- Improved Flagdle rendering for non-2:3 and non-rectangular flags such as Malaysia, Switzerland, and Nepal.
- Cleaned up blog card date formatting and removed raw editorial timestamp lines.
